title: Local bifurcation at a simple Dirichlet eigenvalue
problem: For F(λ,u)=-u''-λu-u² on (0,π) with Dirichlet boundary conditions, X=H²(0,π)∩H¹₀(0,π), Y=L²(0,π), analyze local bifurcation from (λ,u)=(1,0). Verify the simple kernel and Fredholm range of D_uF(1,0), check transversality D_{λu}F(1,0)[sin x]=-sin x, and state the local nontrivial branch conclusion under the simple-eigenvalue bifurcation theorem.

offline_scenario.literature_notes: Fixture: simple-eigenvalue local bifurcation theorem and Dirichlet spectral facts.

methods.name: Simple-eigenvalue bifurcation theorem
methods.rationale: Verify hypotheses at the first Dirichlet eigenvalue.

steps.goal: Define the Banach spaces and smooth nonlinear map
Show the kernel is span{sin x}
Apply the stated local bifurcation theorem
